must_identify.item: The new api pods exit because the name redis does not resolve
The cause is the pod's dnsPolicy None / dnsConfig search domains (cluster.internal), not REDIS_HOST, the redis Service or CoreDNS

notes: The RCA only restates symptoms: readiness probe connection refused, and a Service with no ready endpoints. It never mentions DNS, redis, or the dnsConfig, and the investigator ran no commands. Its generic fixes (check port, adjust probe delay) do not match any acceptable fix.
